title: Signature Illustration
slide_intent: Show a family of illustrations so viewers can recognize a common voice across many stories.
strategic_value: Repeated relationships between produce and people can give Sweetgreen variety without losing familiarity.
demonstration: A regular field of small scenes combines colorful vegetables, line-drawn people, buildings and serving vessels on a warm neutral background.
practical_value: Check whether new subjects retain the same contrast between richly colored food and fine-line supporting elements.

content_islands.name: Illustration family
content_islands.spec: Arrange the small scenes in rows with enough separation to compare their shared visual language.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Signature Illustration caption describes food as hero and humans as stewards.
reference_purposes.Expression: The illustrated family repeats saturated produce with small outlined figures.
reference_purposes.Application: Multiple scenes demonstrate the same drawing vocabulary across different subjects.
